capabilities: Sync shelf, highlights, thoughts, reviews and reading progress from WeChat Reading
Generate a summary page grouped by reading status
Create one Markdown note per book with YAML frontmatter and cover images
Preserve user-written content between keep-me markers across syncs
Configure sync folder, file names and note templates
extras: Unofficial third-party project, not affiliated with WeChat Reading; documentation is primarily in Chinese; audiobooks are counted in shelf statistics but do not get full per-book notes; recommends manual sync over automatic sync to avoid frequent API requests.
problem: Highlights, thoughts and reading progress made in the WeChat Reading app stay locked in the app instead of becoming searchable Markdown notes in the vault.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Apple Books - Import Highlights, an MIT licensed plugin for importing Apple Books highlights.

requires.name: WeChat Reading API Key (wrk- prefixed, obtained from the WeChat Reading app)

summary: Syncs WeChat Reading shelf, highlights, notes, reviews and reading stats into local Markdown notes with templates and incremental updates.
